## Schedule of Dilapidations where prepared by the landlord

[Pre-Action Protocol for Claims for Damages in Relation to the Physical State of Commercial Property at Termination of a Tenancy (the ‘Dilapidations Protocol’) > Schedule of Dilapidations where prepared by the landlord] This schedule has been prepared by [name of landlord][[name of person preparing schedule if landlord is not an individual] on behalf of the landlord]. It was prepared following [name i.e. same name as above]’s inspection of the property known as [property] on [date].

[Pre-Action Protocol for Claims for Damages in Relation to the Physical State of Commercial Property at Termination of a Tenancy (the ‘Dilapidations Protocol’) > Schedule of Dilapidations where prepared by the landlord] It records the works required to be done to the property in order that the property is put into the physical state in which it would have been if the tenant [name] had complied with its covenants or obligations contained within its lease of the property dated [         ].

[Pre-Action Protocol for Claims for Damages in Relation to the Physical State of Commercial Property at Termination of a Tenancy (the ‘Dilapidations Protocol’) > Schedule of Dilapidations where prepared by the landlord] The covenants or obligations of the said lease with which the tenant should have complied are as follows –

[Pre-Action Protocol for Claims for Damages in Relation to the Physical State of Commercial Property at Termination of a Tenancy (the ‘Dilapidations Protocol’) > Schedule of Dilapidations where prepared by the landlord] [Set out clause number of the lease and quote the clause verbatim].

[Pre-Action Protocol for Claims for Damages in Relation to the Physical State of Commercial Property at Termination of a Tenancy (the ‘Dilapidations Protocol’) > Schedule of Dilapidations where prepared by the landlord] The following schedule contains:

[Pre-Action Protocol for Claims for Damages in Relation to the Physical State of Commercial Property at Termination of a Tenancy (the ‘Dilapidations Protocol’) > Schedule of Dilapidations where prepared by the landlord] reference to the specific clause (quoted above) under which the obligation arises,

[Pre-Action Protocol for Claims for Damages in Relation to the Physical State of Commercial Property at Termination of a Tenancy (the ‘Dilapidations Protocol’) > Schedule of Dilapidations where prepared by the landlord] the breach complained of,

[Pre-Action Protocol for Claims for Damages in Relation to the Physical State of Commercial Property at Termination of a Tenancy (the ‘Dilapidations Protocol’) > Schedule of Dilapidations where prepared by the landlord] the remedial works suggested by the landlord as suitable for remedying the breach complained of,

[Pre-Action Protocol for Claims for Damages in Relation to the Physical State of Commercial Property at Termination of a Tenancy (the ‘Dilapidations Protocol’) > Schedule of Dilapidations where prepared by the landlord] the landlord’s view on the cost of the works.

[Pre-Action Protocol for Claims for Damages in Relation to the Physical State of Commercial Property at Termination of a Tenancy (the ‘Dilapidations Protocol’) > Schedule of Dilapidations where prepared by the landlord] The schedule contains the true views of the landlord.

[Pre-Action Protocol for Claims for Damages in Relation to the Physical State of Commercial Property at Termination of a Tenancy (the ‘Dilapidations Protocol’) > Schedule of Dilapidations where prepared by the landlord] Upon receipt of this schedule the tenant should respond using this schedule in the relevant column below to enable the landlord to understand clearly the tenant’s views on each item of claim.

[Pre-Action Protocol for Claims for Damages in Relation to the Physical State of Commercial Property at Termination of a Tenancy (the ‘Dilapidations Protocol’) > Schedule of Dilapidations where prepared by the landlord] ENDORSEMENT

[Pre-Action Protocol for Claims for Damages in Relation to the Physical State of Commercial Property at Termination of a Tenancy (the ‘Dilapidations Protocol’) > Schedule of Dilapidations where prepared by the landlord] I [name, i.e. the same name as above] confirm that in my opinion:

[Pre-Action Protocol for Claims for Damages in Relation to the Physical State of Commercial Property at Termination of a Tenancy (the ‘Dilapidations Protocol’) > Schedule of Dilapidations where prepared by the landlord] all the works set out in the schedule are reasonably required to remedy breaches complained of;

[Pre-Action Protocol for Claims for Damages in Relation to the Physical State of Commercial Property at Termination of a Tenancy (the ‘Dilapidations Protocol’) > Schedule of Dilapidations where prepared by the landlord] full account has been taken of [my] [the landlord’s] intentions for the property; and

[Pre-Action Protocol for Claims for Damages in Relation to the Physical State of Commercial Property at Termination of a Tenancy (the ‘Dilapidations Protocol’) > Schedule of Dilapidations where prepared by the landlord] the costings, if any, are reasonable.
